ocr.archivoNoSoportado: That file is not a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo. If your phone saves in HEIC, switch the camera to a compatible format or take the photo from the app.
ocr.usandoMinimoModelo: This sign has two minimums. You are using {{n}} (per model).
ocr.usandoMinimoTienda: This sign has two minimums. You are using {{n}} (whole shop).
ocr.noLegibleTitulo: Photo not legible — please retake it
ocr.noLegibleImagenSin: The image can't be read clearly.
ocr.noLegibleInstruccion: Retake the photo with good lighting, no glare or overexposure, in focus and with the full sign visible.
ocr.revisarAyuda: Fix anything the system misread. Each field is labeled.
ocr.oCompletaManual: Or fill the fields marked with * by hand to add it anyway.
ocr.errorSistemaTitulo: We couldn't process this photo — it's not your fault
ocr.errorSistemaTexto: The system failed to analyze it on our side. Retaking it won't help. Let support know and retry later; the photo is saved.
ocr.sinSaldoTitulo: The analysis service ran out of balance
ocr.sinSaldoTexto: It's not your photo or an app failure: the account that pays for image analysis ran out of balance. It needs a top-up to work again. Let Marcela or support know; your photo is saved.

pedidos.faltaMarca: Write the shipping mark (client's initials) before generating the order: it's how the store separates these boxes from another order's.
pedidos.confirmar: Generate orders for {{cliente}}? An Excel file will be created for each store.
pedidos.confirmarCliente: Generate the store orders? The system will create one order per store with the quantities {{cliente}} requested.
pedidos.confirmarSinPedido: The client hasn't confirmed their quantities yet. Generate the order to the store anyway with the boxes you loaded?
pedidos.ayudaGenerar: Ask the store for the boxes you loaded in the products table (CTNS column).
pedidos.ayudaGenerarCliente: The system detects which store each product belongs to and creates one order per store — no need to sort them by hand. They're generated with the quantities the client requested; you can edit them above before generating if anything changed at the last minute.
pedidos.regenerar: Need to fix something? Generate the order again

lote.tope: Up to {{max}} photos at a time. We took the first {{max}}.
lote.fallas: {{n}} photo(s) could not be read and were skipped.
lote.segundoPlano: You can close the app: processing continues and you'll see the results when you return.
lote.retomadoParcial: A previous upload was interrupted: resuming with the {{n}} photos that did make it up.
lote.noLegibles: {{n}} photo(s) not legible. Retake them to add those products.
lote.confirmarDescartar: Discard the {{n}} reviewed products? This can't be undone.
lote.errorReanalizar: Could not analyze the photo, try again
lote.completaOReemplaza: Fill the fields marked with * or replace the photo to use it.
lote.resumenTodoListo: ✅ All set: {{n}} products ready to add
lote.exitoFinal: ✅ Done: {{n}} products added to the quotation
lote.falloSistemaTitulo: Analysis failed due to a system problem
lote.falloSistemaTexto: It's not your photos: the system couldn't analyze them. They are already saved, so you don't need to retake them. Let support know and tap «Retry» later.
lote.falloSistemaTextoCortado: It's not your photos: the system couldn't analyze them and stopped so the remaining {{n}} weren't wasted. All of them are saved. Let support know and tap «Retry» later.
lote.falloSaldoTitulo: The analysis service ran out of balance
lote.falloSaldoTexto: It's not your photos or an app failure: the account that pays for image analysis ran out of balance. Let Marcela or support know so they can top it up, then tap «Retry».
lote.falloFotosGuardadas: {{n}} photos were left unanalyzed, but all of them are saved: retrying processes them automatically, you don't need to retake them.
lote.ayudaPaso1: Choose the photos of the signs you took at the market, up to {{max}} at a time. You don't have to type anything yet: the app reads them for you.
lote.ayudaPaso1ConProductos: You already have {{n}} products added to this quote, check them in the "Products" step. You can upload new photos here if you want to add more.
lote.ayudaPaso1Elegidas: Check that they are all here. Add more with the «+» button or remove the ones you don't need. When you are ready, tap «Analyse».
lote.ayudaPaso2: The app is reading the signs, this takes a moment. You can close the screen and do something else: the results will be here when you come back.
lote.ayudaPaso3: Review what the app read and fix whatever is missing. At the end tap the green button and the products move to the quotation list.
lote.fallidasSubidaTexto: This looks like a connection problem. Check your internet and try again: the photos are still on your phone, you haven't lost them.
lote.fallidasSubidaSistemaTexto: This one is on us, not on your photos or your connection: the system that stores them is not responding. Do NOT take them again. Tell Marcela or support and try again later.

advertenciaFotos.titulo: Before you start: check your photos
advertenciaFotos.subtitulo: If a photo is badly taken, the system can't read it. Most errors come from this.
advertenciaFotos.comoTitulo: How to take each photo well
como: Good lighting, no shadows or glare on the label.
In focus and sharp: not shaky or blurry.
The whole label/board visible, not cropped.
Straight on and close, so the text is clearly readable.
advertenciaFotos.datosTitulo: These details MUST be readable in the photo:
advertenciaFotos.consecuencia: If a photo doesn't meet this, the system won't read it and you'll have to retake it.
advertenciaFotos.confirmar: I confirm my photos meet this

recorte.ayuda: This is the original photo. Drag over the product to mark the part you want to show in the quotation and the order to the store.
recorte.muyChico: The box is too small. Mark a larger area over the product.
recorte.error: The crop could not be saved
recorte.actual: This is how it appears today in the quotation and the order. Drag over the photo only if you want to change it.
recorte.ayudaGirada: You rotated the photo. Now drag over the product as it looks here, then save.
recorte.previaCambio: This is how it will look with your crop (not saved yet).
